text: Very happy with this dentist and clinic. I had a molar fall apart and thought i would need a root canal at least or an implant. He did a great job repairing tooth with filling and a temporary crown 👑 that feels perfect now. Just went for 2 week check. He recommended a permanent crown in 2 weeks but said if no issue,  we can go longer before we do. I appreciated that as this was an unexpected but very fair cost. 2000 baht for xray, exam, and temporary crown. He is very thorough and professional. He does not upsale procedures you don't need. His English is very good and he is very kind Doctor.  Will always use this dentist while here in jomtien. Highly recommended.  🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟 🤩
